megan: quick design check — pushed a new role-map prototype. two things: 1) collapsed vs stacked role rows on narrow screens, 2) SSO toggle placement in invite modal (inline vs settings banner). proto: https://img.redwood/proto/rolemap-v4.png :eyes: ryan: saw it. compact rows look great but worried about meaning when collapsed. can we add a chevron + tooltip that says 'show role details'? megan: yup. tooltip + aria-expanded state. on mobile chevron expands an inline panel instead of a flyout. kai: note: expansion state needs analytics. currently audit events only send role_id; add expanded_view boolean so we can measure usage. perf: prefer css-only height toggle to avoid re-rendering large lists. olivia: a11y nits: tooltip needs keyboard target and accessible name. when collapsed, screen readers should still get a permission summary. suggestion: offscreen SR-only text like 'Role: Admin — can deploy, manage models'. ryan: microcopy tweak for SSO confirm. change from 'Require SSO for org?' to 'Require Single Sign-On for all members?' and primary CTA 'Enable SSO for this org', secondary 'Ask to enable later'. clearer. megan: agreed. placement debate: inline in invite modal (below email) vs banner at top of org settings. inline = discovered at invite time; banner = clearer for org-wide changes. kai: inline toggle will trigger settings write call. we should warn about effects: 'Enabling SSO will disable password sign-in for new users.' also surface that in confirmation. olivia: accessibility: modal-level auth changes need a focused confirmation dialog with simple explanation. avoid words like 'tenant' or 'provisioning'. ryan: proposed copy: - Inline label: 'Require Single Sign-On (SSO)' - Helper: 'When enabled, new and existing members must authenticate via your SSO provider.' - Confirm heading: 'Enable SSO for this organization' - Confirm body: 'This will enforce SSO for all members and may change how users sign in. Manage providers in Settings → Security.' - Primary CTA: 'Enable SSO' - Secondary CTA: 'Cancel — review settings' kai: implementation snippet (aria states):
…permissions…
olivia: prefer toggling aria-hidden rather than using hidden attr so SRs update during animation. also ensure focusable controls inside expanded panel are reachable by keyboard. deploy-bot: preview: https://preview.redwood/rolemap-v4 (build: rolemap-v4-2026-03-22) :rocket: megan: next steps: ryan will update copy & tooltip text; kai will add analytics event and aria changes; olivia will write SR-only summaries and test with VoiceOver; i'll open a PR to update invite modal for preview testing. :100: ryan: aiming to post updated frames by EOD PST. kai: will add server flag and perf note in PR. olivia: will test SR text and confirm keyboard behavior. megan: thanks all!
